summary: Frontend E2E testing for ProductDetail.js complete redesign. Verified new Apple-style layout on /products/:slug routes (API-based products) with immersive hero, category-colored gradients, bento specs grid, applications, quote form, and related products. Tested 4 different /products/:slug pages and 3 /indoor-led/:pitch and /outdoor-led/:pitch pages to confirm consistent premium design across both product systems.

code_quality.issue: React warning: Encountered two children with the same key for 'Brightness' and 'Pixel Pitch'. This occurs when fullSpecs array has duplicate labels from both product data fields and key_specs array.
code_quality.suggested_fix: Add unique index to key in fullSpecs.map() or deduplicate specs before rendering
